title: ForeFlight Checklist Completion Gap
dataSources: Flight logs (`flight:log`), flight-plan snapshots (`simbrief:plan`), network sessions (`vatsim:session`), prep tasks (`checkride:prep`), export syncs (`flight:export`).
app: Aviation and flight-sim telemetry — ForeFlight exports, SimBrief flight plans, VATSIM session logs, and checkride-prep trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=flight:log checklist_name=* all_items_completed=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(all_items_completed="yes",1,0))) as matched by checklist_name
| eval every_checklist_item_complete_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - every_checklist_item_complete_pct
description: Measures the percentage of ForeFlight checklist runs that end with every checklist item complete by checklist.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which checklist are helping or hurting ForeFlight checklist runs.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `every checklist item complete` on `flight:log` events and summarize the hit rate by `checklist_name`.
visualization: Table of checklist with percentage of ForeFlight checklist runs ending with every checklist item complete.
grandmaExplanation: It totals how often every checklist item complete happens for each checklist so you can see where ForeFlight checklist runs go smoothly or get stuck.
